protocol.receiver: What is the opposite of "small"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.donor: What is the opposite of "hot"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.contribution: C_f(x) = gate_f(standardized prenorm residual x) * ((standardized x @ V_f) @ U_f) * output_std
protocol.probability_definition: Full-vocabulary next-token softmax, cold token 87072 and large token 16767. Not a renormalized two-choice probability.
protocol.attention: Unfrozen eager attention; original native MLP retained
protocol.formula: MLP_receiver[22,9] += -beta * C_2339(clean receiver) + alpha * C_941(clean donor)
protocol.source_policy: Full gate times low-rank contribution, computed once from unmodified donor/receiver at token9, fixed across all strengths. No source input or gate recomputation under intervention.
protocol.coefficient_semantics: alpha and beta multiply added/subtracted output vectors; beta=.5 subtracts half the clean estimated small contribution. Original MLP is retained; no exact gate replacement.
protocol.refinement: For each beta curve that crosses 99%, bisect the first observed upward crossing bracket eight times; minimum is a tested threshold within that bracket, not a global guarantee.
protocol.generation: Greedy full-prefix decoding up to 24 output tokens, fixed edit only at original prompt token9 in layer22. Response tokens are never directly edited.
protocol.primary_metric: P(cold), token87072, full-vocabulary next-token softmax. No P(hot) target.
protocol.gpu_policy: New SPAR rental; retain GPU and disk after experiment. No stop/delete.
